Recipe.name: Crinkle French Fries
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1, Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen potatoes until golden brown and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain. FOR ONE SERVING: 1. on specified serving dish, place 3 ozw fries. 2. Serve immediately.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: Dill Pickle Slices
Recipe.special_instructions: chopped 1/4" 1 tbl = 3/8 ozw 1-oz spoodle = 3/4 ozw 2-oz spoodle = 1 1/2 ozw 3-oz spoodle = 2 1/4 ozw 4-oz spoodle = 3 ozw 6-oz spoodle = 4 1/2 ozw 8-oz spoodle = 6 ozw IDDSI Level 7

Recipe.name: Crispy Chicken Pepper Jack Slider
Recipe.assembly_instructions: Prepare sub-assembly recipe(s). For one serving: Spread 2 tsp Mayonnaise on cut sides of 1 roll (1 ozw). Layer the following on bottom half of roll: 2 Nuggets (1 1/4 ozw) 1 piece cheese (1/4 ozw) 2-oz spoodle lettuce (1/2 ozw) Top half of roll Serve immediately.

Recipe.name: California Turkey Bacon Wrap
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 2 SERVINGS: 1. Spread 2 tsp dressing over lower two-thirds of 1 tortilla. 2. Layer the following over lower two-thirds of tortilla: 2 slices tomato 2 slices avocado 2-oz spoodle lettuce 1 1/2 ozw turkey 1 slice Turkey Bacon Fold lower third of tortilla up over filling. Fold in right and left edges of tortilla about 1" on each side. Roll wrap closed. Place seam side down. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep chilled for service.

Recipe.name: Italian Wrap
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 2 SERVINGS: 1. Spread 1 tbl dressing over lower two-thirds of 1 tortilla. 2. Layer the following over lower two-thirds of tortilla: 8-oz spoodle lettuce 4 pieces tomato 1 slice onion, separated into rings 1/2 oz ham 1/2 oz salami 2 pieces cheese Fold lower third of tortilla up over filling. Fold in right and left edges of tortilla about 1" on each side. Roll wrap closed. Place seam side down. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Place 1 piece of sandwich in specified packaging with label. 5. Keep chilled for service.

Recipe.name: Crunchy Corn Dogs
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 325 F. 2. On sheet pan(s) coated with cooking spray, place corn dogs 1" apart. 3. Bake until internal temperature reaches 140 F, 20 to 25 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen chicken patties until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of roll: 1 chicken patty Top half of roll 2. Keep hot for service.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: Grilled Black Bean Burger
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat char-grill to medium or flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook frozen burgers 4 minutes. Turn burgers over. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 5 minutes. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of 1 roll: 1 burger Top half of roll 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Grilled Herb Chicken Sandwich
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of roll: 1 piece Chicken Top half of roll 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: BURGER/SDW TRIM SALAD - LETTUCE, TOMATO, PICKLE
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat char-grill to medium or flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook frozen burgers 2 minutes. Turn burgers over. Cook until internal temperature reaches 160 F, 2 to 3 minutes. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of 1 roll: 1 burger Top half of roll 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.
